newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Mali's president ends visit to Libya.
newsitem.headline: Mali's president ends visit to Libya.

text.p: Mali's President Alpha Oumar Konare left Tripoli on Thursday after talks with Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi on bilateral cooperation and African issues, the official Libyan news agency JANA reported.
The agency, monitored in Tunis, said Konare, who arrived on Tuesday night, met Gaddafi twice. It gave not further details.
Before his Libyan trip, Konare visited Algiers where he had talks with President Liamine Zeroual.
